title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1988-09-23
source: (original shnid = 5291) Soundboard> Master Cassette> DAT> CD; Seeded by Charlie Miller; Converted to SHN and treed by Frank Venezia - pitch correction and patches by Kevin Tobin

ai_review.summary: Mislabeled audience recording plagued by heavy crowd noise; musical performance details unavailable
ai_review.review: The sole reviewer condemns this tape as a mislabeled audience capture, noting that the mix is dominated by crowd chatter rather than a clean soundboard feed. No comments are made about the band's playing or specific songs, and the low one‑star rating reflects overall disappointment with the recording quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review giving a 1‑star rating; reviewer focuses on poor, crowd‑heavy recording and provides no positive show details.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy crowd microphone bleed; not a true soundboard source, resulting in muffled instrument clarity.
